name: What types of paint and finishes are best for storm resistance in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What types of paint and finishes are best for storm resistance in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: For storm resistance in the Bay Area, acrylic latex paints are generally recommended for exteriors due to their flexibility, durability, and resistance to moisture, mildew, and UV radiation. Finishes with higher sheen levels (satin, semi-gloss) tend to be more durable and easier to clean than flat finishes. Additionally, consider paints specifically formulated with advanced binders and resins that offer enhanced protection against wind-driven rain, salt air exposure, and temperature fluctuations common to the region.
acceptedAnswer.description: Acrylic latex paints with higher sheens are best for storm resistance in the Bay Area, offering durability against moisture, UV, and salt air.
